text:
Situation: FDA first posted the furosemide injection shortage on 2020-04-07 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. Our inventory shows injection supply at Corvale East (8.5 days) and Corvale Lakeside (28 days). Oral tablet supply ranges from 17.3 to 26.6 days across sites.

Why (FDA record): The Accord Healthcare label for furosemide names Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, 214 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1191818 at Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited ended 2022-12-02 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-04-05. Import alert 66-40 was issued for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited on 2023-06-01 and again on 2023-11-14. Warning letters were issued to Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited on 2023-07-28 and 2023-11-21.

Our position: Injection inventory is critically low at Corvale East. Oral inventory is adequate but requires monitoring. The preferred procurement path is a supplier not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC for furosemide injection; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as secondary injection source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Cardinal Health 107, LLC as tertiary injection source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to maintain current oral tablet contracts; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to report weekly inventory days-on-hand for all sites to P&T Committee; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Do not procure from Accord Healthcare or any supplier listing Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited as the manufacturing plant while import alert 66-40 and warning letters remain active. Do not initiate clinical protocol changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
